entry.title: Stochastic High-Resolution Parameter-Based Channel Modeling for Sub-Terahertz Outdoor Device-to-Device Propagation at 145 GHz
entry.summary: A complete model that can generate double-directional impulse responses for sub-THz device-to-device channels, with sparse multipath components clustered from an extensive measurement campaign.

entry.title: GeoJeV: Unified Spatial Probability for Training-Free Efficient Evidence Acquisition in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
entry.summary: Evidence acquisition is formulated as spatial probability-driven decision making, reducing reliance on reinforcement learning from human feedback.

entry.title: Sparse Array Interpolation for Wideband Angular Estimation
entry.summary: Interpolating a sparse array with a learned prior keeps the angular resolution of a dense array at a fraction of the elements.

entry.title: Photonic Integrated Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution with a Silicon Nitride Comb
entry.summary: An on-chip comb source distributes secret keys over a 25 kilometre fibre link without any active stabilization.

entry.title: Full-Vector Modal Analysis of Bent Silicon Waveguides
entry.summary: A full-vector mode solver quantifies the polarization conversion a bend introduces in a single-mode rib waveguide.

entry.title: Machine-Learning-Assisted Lensless Imaging at the Detector Shot-Noise Limit
entry.summary: Reconstruction from a bare sensor reaches the shot-noise limit of a lensless setup across a 3.2 millimetre field.

entry.title: Nonlinear Pulse Shaping in an Arched Hollow-Core Fibre
entry.summary: Soliton self-compression to eighteen femtoseconds is demonstrated in a gas-filled arched fibre.

entry.title: Phase Retrieval from a Single Defocused Image with a Fixed Point Network
entry.summary: A fixed-point architecture replaces iterative phase retrieval while keeping the reconstruction error bounded.

entry.title: Mid-Infrared Supercontinuum Generation in a Cascaded Chalcogenide Waveguide
entry.summary: Cascading two chalcogenide waveguides widens the generated supercontinuum without raising the pump power.
